motivation: Zhou et al. (AISTATS 2021) select the oracle on a separate validation set, which removes test reuse; CDALBench (2024) and BoSS (2026) select on the test split. Does outcome luck remain after the split, along full learning curves?

common.phat: GBDT as supplement-v6 on records disjoint from T, V, Q, history and stream (cap 20000)

strategies: Random, Uncertainty, BAIT-greedy, TargetVar-greedy, Fisher-cost; DC-PRISM omitted because it may acquire fewer than b labels by design

inference.method: paired t over seeds, Bonferroni simultaneous intervals and Holm within each registered family

predictions.P1: MAIN, whole-curve ALC: outcome luck = ALC(oracle-exante) - ALC(oracle-split) is material positive (simultaneous interval above 0.5e-3) in at least the 4 datasets with the highest noise index; Spearman(noise index, luck share of the split-oracle lead over the best strategy) > 0.
predictions.P2: MAIN: the test-reuse share of the test-oracle lead over the best strategy is larger in the late window (steps 21-30) than in the early window (steps 1-10) in at least 6/8 datasets.
predictions.P3: MAIN: every strategy falls materially short of oracle-test in 8/8 datasets and of oracle-split in at least 6/8 datasets; every strategy falls materially short of oracle-exante in at most 4/8 datasets.
predictions.P4: BIGV (validation set four times the test set): luck remains material positive in at least 3/4 datasets.

stopping: fixed sizes; no interim looks; no additional seeds after results
development: smoke tests use seed 99001 only (2 steps, R=2)
